dialogue.text: I heard it too. I know what it sounds like to you. Stay with me anyway.
Garrick's crew stopped digging. Why? Did anyone say what happened down there?
Whose barn is this, and who has the key?
Breathe. It only says what it's heard. Keep the light up.
Let it call. We're not walking down there blind.

options.label: Ask Wick something
options.detail: he is at your shoulder with the open lantern

options.label: Cut the barn's chain with the lightsaber
options.detail: the blade is lit; cutting metal throws sparks and light

options.label: Force the padlock or the hasp
Look over the welding cart by the left-hand silo
options.detail: Intelligence (Investigation); about 35 ft away, at the edge of your light

options.label: Study the sealed door of Silo Three
options.detail: Intelligence (Investigation); the bar, the welds and the slag; about 30 ft back

options.label: Listen toward the strip of trees
options.detail: Wisdom (Perception); the trees are about 1,700 ft away down the rise

options.label: Open the comm channel again
options.detail: the shuttle has lifted; who would answer is unknown

objects.label: Tell Wick to close the lantern shutter
Take the welding torch from the cart
Lift the first gas bottle off the cart
Lift the second gas bottle off the cart

movement.label: Cross the lane to the other barn (~25 ft)
Back to the door of Silo Three (~30 ft)
Down the lane to the Grange door (~280 ft)
Down the rise toward the trees and the voice (~1,700 ft)

visible.label: Wick (at your shoulder, within reach, lantern open and raised)
The nearest barn's doors: hasp, heavy chain, padlock
The other barn, across the lane, doors shut
Silo Three, the middle silo: barred, seam welded, grey slag on the gravel under it
A handcart with a welding torch and two gas bottles, against the left-hand silo
The Grange, down the lane: thin yellow lines at its shutters; the door shut and bolted

notes: You are at the nearest barn beside the silos, blade lit in your right hand, blaster drawn in your left. Wick is at your shoulder, within reach, lantern raised.
The barn is chained and padlocked. Cutting or forcing it will make light and noise.

Wick says: the Warden is Marga Tolliver; her son Garrick is one of the six, with his mother; Silo Three was welded the day after the dogs went wrong; Garrick's crew had been digging under it all season, then stopped.
The woman's voice called once, faint, from the strip of trees about 1,700 ft down the rise: the same words as every time. Nothing else came.
Blade and lantern light reach about 10-20 ft; past that it is dark. You have no darkvision. Your lights can be seen from a long way off.
The comm channel is closed. The shuttle has gone; you have no ride.
The voice can repeat words it has heard, yours included, word for word.
